name: python-hybrid-clock
title: Hybrid logical clock
blurb: Wall clocks go backwards, and a distributed system cannot afford to. This stack implements a hybrid logical clock and proves the two invariants it exists for: every stamp a node hands out is strictly later than its last one whatever the wall clock does, and a message never arrives stamped before it was sent, even when the receiver's clock runs 500 ms slow. It also measures the cost of the guarantee: skew in milliseconds per node, a bound that turns skew into a refusal, and the inversions a naive wall-clock sort produces on the same events.
default_description: A hybrid logical clock that keeps causality across skewed wall clocks, with the skew measured rather than assumed.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
